extracted.intended_audience: researchers and readers interested in preprint peer-review and recommendation practices in evolutionary biology
extracted.subtask_description: A concise profile of how a specific recommendation service (Peer Community in Evolutionary Biology) conducts free, transparent preprint peer-review and recommendation, using Sciety's PReF descriptors. Useful for readers comparing review workflows and for authors submitting preprints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free and transparent preprint peer-review and recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: Free and transparent preprint peer-review and recommendation by and for researchers in Evolutionary Biology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement of the group's mission and overall evaluative approach; signals transparency and community-run recommendation rather than traditional closed journal review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of PReF (preprint review features) descriptors
rubrics_metrics.description: Sciety uses the PReF (preprint review features) descriptors to describe key elements of each Group's evaluation activities, helping readers to interpret and compare their evaluations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that the group's review attributes are standardized and comparable across services using PReF; 'Learn more' link available for full descriptor definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review requested by
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies who initiates the review process; here reviews are initiated by the preprint's authors requesting evaluation/recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer selected by
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates who chooses the reviewer(s): could be an assigned editor, the service itself, or the broader community; affects independence and selection transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public interaction
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Denotes whether there is an open/public interaction channel (e.g., public commenting); 'No' indicates the review discussion is not publicly interactive on the platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of author response
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies whether authors' responses to reviews are included in the record; 'Yes' indicates authors can/respond do provide a reply that is retained with the review materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the type of outcome reported: a binary decision typically means recommended/not recommended (accept/reject equivalent) rather than graded or multi-tiered decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review coverage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the scope of the review: 'Complete paper' means the entire manuscript is evaluated rather than only selected figures, an abstract, or a subset.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer identity known to
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates who is aware of the reviewer's identity; here reviewers are known to the editor or the service but not necessarily publicly disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competing interests
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows that competing interests are assessed/checked as part of the review process; implies a conflict-of-interest screening step is performed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content license for comments, reviews and recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors of comments, reviews and recommendations retain copyright© under CC BY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies licensing and reuse: reviewers and recommenders retain copyright but grant a CC BY license for their content, enabling broad reuse with attribution.
